title: SAGED: A Holistic Bias-Benchmarking Pipeline for Language Models with Customisable Fairness Calibration
reasoning: The paper describes a holistic benchmarking pipeline for LLMs that explicitly measures and evaluates fairness (ethics) and includes built-in classifiers for 'religion_score' and stereotypes. It defines bias in an 'ethically significant sense' and provides a framework for fairness calibration across different ideologies.
